name: Natal Chart Reading
purpose: A first look at your birth chart as a whole: the patterns that repeat across it, the current conditions surrounding you now, and the questions that become clearer when those pieces are read together.
method: We begin by looking for the patterns that carry the most weight across the natal chart rather than moving through a list of placements. Then I bring in relevant transits, progressions, and other timing techniques to understand what is especially active now. I explain what I am seeing and why; your questions and lived experience help us refine which possibilities are actually meaningful in your life.
bestFor: New clients who want to understand the chart as a whole rather than collect separate placement meanings
Seeing which themes repeat strongly enough to deserve attention and how you are actually living them
A meaningful crossroads, recurring pattern, or season of change that could use a wider view of what is active now
notFor: Existing clients wanting a focused follow-up: Want More Clarity or a Quick Check-In fits better
A consultation focused on two people's charts together: choose the Relationship Consultation

options.label: 90 minutes: the full tour
options.note: Recommended for first readings: more room for the natal chart, current conditions, and your questions.

intakeRequirements: Exact birth time (birth certificate if possible)
The focus you want, via the intake form after booking
includes: The strongest repeating patterns across the chart, rather than an isolated tour of placements
Relevant transits, progressions, and current planetary conditions around your natal chart
Connections between the symbolism and the questions or circumstances you are actually living
A guided conversation with room for as much or as little feedback as feels natural to you
deliverables: A copy of your natal chart
preparation: Confirm your birth time from a birth certificate if you can
Bring two or three real questions you're living with
